annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/1329 of 13 May 2024 amending and correcting Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 as regards harmonised standards for explosion prevention and protection in explosive atmospheres, laser related equipment, safety-related parts of control systems, plastics and rubber machines, refuse collection vehicles, aircraft ground support equipment, driverless industrial trucks and their systems, and other machinery
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/1329 of 13 May 2024 amending and correcting Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 as regards harmonised standards for machinery (including driverless industrial trucks and safety-related parts of control systems)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: This European Commission implementing decision amends and corrects the list of harmonised standards under the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC that was set by Decision 2023/1586. Machinery built to these standards is presumed to meet the directive's essential health and safety requirements. The new listings include EN ISO 3691-4:2023 on driverless industrial trucks, EN ISO 13849-1:2023 and EN ISO 25119 on safety-related parts of control systems.
key_provisions_or_claims: Publishes EN ISO 3691-4:2023 (driverless industrial trucks) as a harmonised standard conferring presumption of conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC
Replaces EN ISO 13849-1:2015 with EN ISO 13849-1:2023 on safety-related parts of control systems, with deferred withdrawal of the old version
Adds EN ISO 25119 parts 1-4 on safety-related control systems for agricultural and forestry tractors and machinery
Publishes EN 15700:2023 and EN 15194:2017+A1:2023 with restrictions on presumption of conformity
Enters into force on publication, with staggered withdrawal dates through May 2027
